TABLE.NAME: enrol_mercadopagocpro_txn
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per Mercado Pago Checkout Pro preference created by this plugin, tracking the resulting payment and the enrolment it produced.

FIELD.NAME: enrolid
FIELD.COMMENT: Enrolment instance this transaction belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Denormalised course id, kept so the record survives instance deletion for auditing.

FIELD.NAME: externalreference
FIELD.COMMENT: Signed external_reference sent to Mercado Pago in the preference.

FIELD.NAME: preferenceid
FIELD.COMMENT: Preference id returned by POST /checkout/preferences.

FIELD.NAME: paymentid
FIELD.COMMENT: Mercado Pago payment id (GET /v1/payments/{id}).

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Local mirror of the Mercado Pago payment status.

FIELD.NAME: enrolmentstate
FIELD.COMMENT: none|pending|active|suspended|unenrolled - what this plugin has done with the enrolment.

FIELD.NAME: marketplacefee
FIELD.COMMENT: marketplace_fee sent in the preference when split payments are enabled.

FIELD.NAME: sellerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Mercado Pago collector/seller user id used for this transaction.

FIELD.NAME: livemode
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 when the transaction was produced with test credentials.

FIELD.NAME: initpoint
FIELD.COMMENT: init_point / sandbox_init_point the user was redirected to.

FIELD.NAME: metadata
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON metadata sent in the preference.

FIELD.NAME: lastapipayload
FIELD.COMMENT: Redacted copy of the last payment payload received from the API, for troubleshooting.

FIELD.NAME: timeexpires
FIELD.COMMENT: expiration_date_to sent in the preference.

TABLE.NAME: enrol_mercadopagocpro_wh
TABLE.COMMENT: Audit log of every webhook notification received on the plugin endpoint, including rejected ones.

FIELD.NAME: txnid
FIELD.COMMENT: Transaction this notification resolved to, when it could be matched.

FIELD.NAME: notificationid
FIELD.COMMENT: Top level id of the notification body.

FIELD.NAME: requestid
FIELD.COMMENT: x-request-id header.

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: Notification type, e.g. payment.

FIELD.NAME: action
FIELD.COMMENT: Notification action, e.g. payment.updated.

FIELD.NAME: dataid
FIELD.COMMENT: data.id of the notification.

FIELD.NAME: httpstatus
FIELD.COMMENT: Status code returned to Mercado Pago.

FIELD.NAME: nextretry
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp for the next internal retry of a deferred notification.

FIELD.NAME: payload
FIELD.COMMENT: Redacted notification body.

TABLE.NAME: enrol_mercadopagocpro_cred
TABLE.COMMENT: Per enrolment instance Mercado Pago credentials, stored encrypted and deliberately kept out of the enrol table so they are never included in course backups.

FIELD.NAME: accesstoken
FIELD.COMMENT: Encrypted with core\encryption.

FIELD.NAME: publickey
FIELD.COMMENT: Encrypted with core\encryption.

FIELD.NAME: webhooksecret
FIELD.COMMENT: Encrypted with core\encryption.

FIELD.NAME: refreshtoken
FIELD.COMMENT: Encrypted OAuth refresh token when the seller was connected through OAuth.
